question: Where do the dead and wise go according to tanmatras?
premises: The dead go to that supreme earth.
The wise go to the ocean city.
It is attainable by holding the taste tanmatra.
inference: Different tanmatra-holdings determine distinct postmortem destinations.
uncertainties: Whether budhāḥ modifies mṛtā or is separate.
plain_english: The dead go to that supreme earth; the wise go to the ocean city, attainable by holding the taste tanmatra.
